MAPA7-01.note: Key keeps 'no income gain but better able to cover lumpy expenses'. Distractors keep their roles: more businesses, a side benefit (trust/savings), and regional poverty reduction.

MAPA7-02.note: 'Taller and better fed' matches 'greater height, fewer stress markers', and the adapted passage frames stress as poor nutrition. The density and calories options are still points the author grants, and the refusal option is still off-target.

MAPA7-03.note: 'Little or no' became 'little', and 'pre-registered' became 'planned'. Neither changes what the finding signals. Distractors are kept: task-specific gap, dose-response, trainability.

MAPA7-04.note: 'Low water table despite heavy, sustained wolf presence' becomes 'water was low despite many wolves for years'. Same finding. The three distractors map one-to-one.

MAPA7-05.note: The key keeps 'mere co-residence, no shared goals or support, lasting reduction'. 'No goals' drops the word 'shared' but the meaning survives. Distractors still confirm or fit the passage's own claims (the fading point is still in the passage).

MAPA7-06.note: Small drift: 'unpredictable access to food' became 'often short on food', which reads more as scarcity than unpredictability. Still best given 'how stable the child's home has been'. The trait-supporting, age and weakening (broken-promise) distractors are intact.

MAPA7-07.note: Key preserved: removes self-marks unlike anything seen while cleaning. The supporting option (quick to spot blemishes), mirror-time option and ape comparison all keep their roles.

MAPA7-08.note: 'Generations later, once church-led schooling campaigns began' became 'many years later, once church schools opened'. Slightly weaker in time but the same finding. Book-volume, Latin-trade and early-rise (weakener) distractors are preserved.

MAPA7-09.note: 'Time-lapse imaging' became 'photos', and 'liquid water cannot exist' became 'water would be frozen solid'. Same finding. The resemblance, distant-clay and gravity-alone distractors keep their roles.

MAPA7-10.note: The key keeps the full freshwater-to-slower-sinking-to-less-heat chain. Distractors keep their roles: the all-Europe outcome, the melt step only, and tropical warming.

MAPA7-11.note: 'Commercial institutions' became 'those business skills', which matches the adapted passage's own summary line. The spending, adviser-pay and rural-literacy distractors are preserved.

MAPA7-12.note: 'Exposed to diverse environmental microbes' became 'living near varied microbes'. That is slightly looser but the same contrast. The clean-homes option still fits both versions, and the adult-infection and historical-prevalence distractors are kept.
